from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyTaxRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single company's tax expense record extracted from one financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company")
    income_tax_expense: float | None = Field(description="The income tax expense amount from the report")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_tax_records: list[CompanyTaxRecord]
